item.title: rach3 0.13.0
item.description: Lessons made from a MIDI file get a proper score: one grand staff with the file's key, meter and tempo, triplets written as triplets, and notes spelled for the key. In MIDI lessons each note goes to the hand that plays it: from the file's hand tracks when it names them, otherwise the way a pianist would play it. Signed in to ChatGPT, Create a Lesson can check a new lesson and move notes to the hand that should play them. The box is on by default; the original lesson goes to the Trash. On the Mac, the Customize button takes clicks again.

item.title: rach3 0.12.0
item.description: On Windows, Create a Lesson with ChatGPT and changing rach3 by asking ChatGPT are here, as on the Mac. They need Windows 11 version 24H2 or newer with the latest Windows updates. rach3 is now the same app on Mac and Windows: the same window, the same menus and the same features on both. Your lessons, your settings and the versions you made with ChatGPT stay as they are. This update is a larger download than usual.

item.title: rach3 0.11.0
item.description: Create a Lesson starts with ChatGPT: say the piece you want, and it searches the web and shows YouTube videos, MIDI files you can listen to and score pages. Pick one and it becomes a lesson. Change rach3 by asking ChatGPT: a new button, a different look, a feature you miss. Every change is a new version you can go back from; the original app stays untouched. Both use your own ChatGPT account. Sign in from the app; rach3 shows how much of your plan you used. PDF scores open full window with zoom, and video lessons separate the voice from the piano.

item.title: rach3 0.10.0
item.description: A new name, a new icon and a new website: rach3.com. The title bar and the app's top bar are now one bar, and the lesson title has more room. Falling notes are plain bars by default. Turn on note names and small staves in the settings. The score now sits on a dark background.

item.title: Piano Spark 0.9.3
item.description: While listening, click a measure on the score to play from the start of that measure. Piano Spark is now open source under the AGPL-3.0, and the app remains a public beta.

item.title: Piano Spark 0.9.2
item.description: Windows updates now download only what changed since your version, and every part is checked against the signed release list before it is installed. No changes for Mac in this version.

item.title: Piano Spark 0.9.1
item.description: Piano Spark is now also available for Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) as a beta. Download it from the website. The Mac and Windows apps now share the same lesson engine; lessons on the Mac are created exactly as before.

item.title: Piano Spark 0.9.0
item.description: Piano Spark now runs on Intel Macs too: one download works on both Apple Silicon and Intel. Lessons from videos, YouTube links, MIDI files and sheet-music PDFs can be created on Intel; removing vocals takes longer there because it runs on the processor. Fixed lesson creation stopping with “No module named 'audioread'” when vocal separation was turned on.

item.title: Piano Spark 0.8.0
item.description: Create practice profiles so people sharing a piano keep separate progress; earlier progress stays in the Default profile. Measure each hand's span on your piano: hold the two farthest keys you comfortably reach for three seconds. Chords wider than your span keep the melody and bass required; out-of-reach notes are dimmed and optional, and accepted when played. Lessons, scores, listening and MIDI export always keep every note; only practice targets adapt.

item.title: Piano Spark 0.7.0
item.description: Move to the previous or next practice section at any time with the arrows beside the practice status, even after finishing the plan. Row mastery is now tracked per section: skipping ahead never marks a row as learned and going back keeps earned progress. After mastering a section, practice continues with the next unfinished one and returns to any you skipped; existing progress is preserved.

item.title: Piano Spark 0.6.1
item.description: Row practice now starts each row on its own first chord instead of asking you to briefly replay notes left over from the previous measure. Row boundaries follow the performed downbeat, so notes played slightly before or after a barline stay in the right row; notes really held into a row are still practiced there.

item.title: Piano Spark 0.6.0
item.description: Practice each score row until you reach your clean-repetition goal, or build up rows progressively. Choose 3, 5, or 10 consecutive clean passes and Off, Easy, Normal, or Hard timing. Resume saved practice progress separately for each lesson, part, speed, method, and timing setting. See row status and mastery percentages beside the score, with combined-stage and overall plan progress. Keep falling notes clear with compact practice feedback in the bottom timeline. All practice methods require a connected piano and pause on disconnection; improved interface translations.

item.title: Piano Spark 0.5.0
item.description: Discover nearby Bluetooth MIDI instruments and choose which piano to connect to, across brands. Save and rename pianos, choose a default device, and configure MIDI output channels 1–16. See separate MIDI input and output status, with a short test note available on request. Enable optional automatic connection and bounded reconnect attempts without automatically resuming playback. Improved connection guidance and preserved saved lessons, tools, and workspace preferences.

item.title: Piano Spark 0.4.1
item.description: Install by dragging Piano Spark from the DMG to Applications. Removed the separate Installer app and its additional security approval. Saved lessons and downloaded tools are preserved when updating.

item.title: Piano Spark 0.4.0
item.description: A much smaller Mac installer. Open the DMG to install Piano Spark. Download transcription, vocal removal and PDF tools only when needed. See download size, real progress and speed where you create a lesson. Cancel and resume without losing downloaded files. Downloaded tools stay on your Mac across app updates.

item.title: Piano Spark 0.3.4
item.description: Choose English or Türkçe without leaving your lesson. Language preference is saved between sessions. Menus, practice controls, and lesson creation follow your selected language. Improved standalone score loading.
